source_coverage.pearls_organic: 6/6 evidence source covered, including species-specific agarwood/Chen Xiang evidence

truthfulness_boundary: Generated SVG assets are not source photos and must not be labelled as photographed material.
Low/mid/high is a visual reference system, not supplier AA/AAA or a universal price grade.
Dark-wood generated asset is not itself proof of agarwood species identity.
No copyright-unclear ecommerce binary has been copied into the public repository.

optional_external_photo_upgrade.ownership_boundary: GPT remains responsible; do not transfer image search/download/cutout responsibility to Codex.

next_recommended_action: Workbench may now consume generated-asset-manifest-v1.json and the committed SVG atlases. Only refine individual species visuals when visual review reveals a concrete recognition problem.
